lines.zh: 裂缝里漏出光，我一步步走。
lines.en: Light leaks from my cracks as I take each step.

lines.zh: 每走一步，肩上的石片就响。
lines.en: Every step rattles the stone plates on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧朝圣路往北走。
lines.en: I walk north along the old pilgrim road.

lines.zh: 脚掌碎了一角，还能走。
lines.en: A corner of my foot broke off; I can still walk.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，念到第七句就忘。
lines.en: I count my steps and lose the seventh verse.

lines.zh: 麦田在左边，我绕过去。
lines.en: The wheat field lies left; I go around it.

lines.zh: 前面有人吗？我要开始讲道。
lines.en: Is anyone ahead? I am about to begin preaching.

lines.zh: 我拖着半截衣袍走过石阶。
lines.en: I drag half a robe across the stone stairs.

lines.zh: 膝盖的缝隙卡进了沙子。
lines.en: Sand has lodged in the gap of my knee.

lines.zh: 走过神殿废墟，我放慢脚步。
lines.en: Passing the ruined temple, I slow my pace.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，因为不敢弯腰。
lines.en: I walk very straight, afraid to bend.

lines.zh: 碎石从身上掉，我留一路记号。
lines.en: Chips fall from me, marking the whole road.

lines.zh: 风穿过我胸口那道裂口。
lines.en: Wind passes through the crack in my chest.

lines.zh: 每一步都比上一步轻一点。
lines.en: Each step is a little lighter than the last.

lines.zh: 我绕过一摊水，怕湿了纸页。
lines.en: I skirt a puddle so the pages stay dry.

lines.zh: 石阶缺了一级，我跨得小心。
lines.en: A step is missing; I cross it carefully.

lines.zh: 我站着，裂缝慢慢扩大。
lines.en: I stand still, and the cracks slowly widen.

lines.zh: 经文的下一句，我想不起来。
lines.en: I cannot recall the next line of scripture.

lines.zh: 手里的纸页被风吹得发抖。
lines.en: The pages in my hand tremble in the wind.

lines.zh: 我数身上掉了几块石头。
lines.en: I count how many stones have fallen off me.

lines.zh: 没有信徒，我也照样开口。
lines.en: With no congregation, I still speak.

lines.zh: 光从缝里透出来，像灯。
lines.en: Light shines through my seams like a lamp.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的钟，只有一声。
lines.en: I hear a distant bell, only one stroke.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾被供在堂上。
lines.en: I remember being enshrined in a hall.

lines.zh: 纸角卷了，我用手按平。
lines.en: A page corner curls; I press it flat.

lines.zh: 我试着合掌，手指掉了一节。
lines.en: I try to clasp my hands; a finger joint falls.

lines.zh: 沉默很久，我又开始念。
lines.en: After a long silence, I begin to recite again.

lines.zh: 身上最深的裂缝在背后。
lines.en: The deepest crack on me runs down my back.

lines.zh: 有人供过麦穗，我记得那味道。
lines.en: Someone offered wheat once; I remember the taste.

lines.zh: 我抬头，屋顶早就没有了。
lines.en: I look up; the roof has long been gone.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的碎石一颗颗摆齐。
lines.en: I line up the fallen chips one by one.

lines.zh: 风把纸页翻过去，我又翻回来。
lines.en: The wind turns a page; I turn it back.

lines.zh: 你来了，我正好讲到第三段。
lines.en: You arrived; I am just at the third passage.

lines.zh: 你身上有纸和墨的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of paper and ink.

lines.zh: 别怕，我的裂缝不咬人。
lines.en: Do not fear; my cracks do not bite.

lines.zh: 你愿意听我讲完吗？
lines.en: Would you stay and hear me finish?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在数你的影子。
lines.en: I stare at you, counting your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛是完整的，真好。
lines.en: Your eyes are whole. That is good.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，光太亮了。
lines.en: I cannot see you clearly; the light is too bright.

lines.zh: 你也碎过吗？我认得那纹路。
lines.en: Have you broken too? I know that pattern.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我怕掉渣在你身上。
lines.en: Not too close; my dust might fall on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的书，借我看看。
lines.en: The book in your hand — may I look?

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找信徒的样子。
lines.en: I search your face for the look of a believer.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我听见纸响。
lines.en: When you blink, I hear paper rustle.

lines.zh: 又碎了一角，不碍事。
lines.en: Another corner broke off; no matter.

lines.zh: 打我做什么，我早不完整。
lines.en: Why strike me? I have been incomplete for ages.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起塌顶那天。
lines.en: This blow recalls the day the roof came down.

lines.zh: 裂口更深了，光漏得更多。
lines.en: The crack deepens; more light escapes.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只掉石粉。
lines.en: I do not bleed; I only shed stone dust.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，像旧伤复发。
lines.en: There is pain, like an old wound returning.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还要讲道。
lines.en: Not the face; I still have a sermon to give.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，又站稳了。
lines.en: I step back once and hold my ground.

lines.zh: 这一拳，把我的袖子震掉了。
lines.en: That blow shook my sleeve loose.

lines.zh: 碎的是壳，念的那句还在。
lines.en: The shell breaks; the verse remains.

lines.zh: 麦穗…我很久没吃过供物。
lines.en: Wheat... I have not tasted an offering in ages.

lines.zh: 把那束麦子举高，我看得清。
lines.en: Lift that bundle of wheat; I can see it better.

lines.zh: 我伸手了，慢一些，别撒了。
lines.en: I reach out; go slowly, do not spill it.

lines.zh: 纸的味道比麦子更让我饿。
lines.en: The smell of paper makes me hungrier than wheat.

lines.zh: 这书页是新的，谁写的？
lines.en: These pages are new. Who wrote them?

lines.zh: 给我一页，我能补上那段。
lines.en: Give me one page, and I can mend that passage.

lines.zh: 我跟着麦香走，忘了脚疼。
lines.en: I follow the scent of wheat and forget my aching feet.

lines.zh: 供品该放石台上，不是手里。
lines.en: Offerings belong on the stone altar, not in your hand.

lines.zh: 别用麦子引我，我会一直跟。
lines.en: Do not lure me with wheat; I will follow forever.

lines.zh: 我嚼不动了，可还是想吃。
lines.en: I can barely chew, yet I still want to eat.

lines.zh: 你捏着那本书，走慢一点。
lines.en: You are holding that book; walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 经卷缺的那页，在你怀里？
lines.en: Is the missing page of my scroll in your coat?

lines.zh: 我闻到墨，喉咙就发紧。
lines.en: I smell ink, and my throat tightens.

lines.zh: 我把麦粒藏进裂缝里。
lines.en: I tuck the wheat grains into a crack.

lines.zh: 你手里那卷纸，边角发黄。
lines.en: That scroll in your hand has yellowed edges.

lines.zh: 供过的果子上还留着水珠。
lines.en: The offered fruit still beads with water.

lines.zh: 撞上来，我肩上掉了一块。
lines.en: You bumped me; a piece of my shoulder fell.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的胳膊太脆。
lines.en: Sorry, my arm is too brittle.

lines.zh: 别推，我一歪就散。
lines.en: Do not push; one tilt and I come apart.

lines.zh: 你踩到石头了，那是我。
lines.en: You stepped on a stone; that was me.

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音，像瓷器裂开。
lines.en: The sound of it is like porcelain cracking.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，裂缝又长一寸。
lines.en: I step back, and the crack grows an inch.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你听见里面的风吗？
lines.en: This close, do you hear the wind inside me?

lines.zh: 我的碎片有没有扎到你？
lines.en: Did any of my shards cut you?

lines.zh: 让一让，我得捡回那块。
lines.en: Let me pass; I must pick up that piece.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块旧碑。
lines.en: We knock together like two old gravestones.

lines.zh: 我这样的身子，还能有伴吗？
lines.en: Could a body like mine still have a companion?

lines.zh: 另一个使徒早碎在殿里。
lines.en: The other apostle shattered in the hall long ago.

lines.zh: 成双的经文，我只剩半句。
lines.en: Of the paired verses, I keep only half a line.

lines.zh: 别为我找伴，我会压碎对方。
lines.en: Do not find me a mate; I would crush them.

lines.zh: 我曾与人并肩念过一整夜。
lines.en: I once recited all night beside someone.

lines.zh: 裂缝对着裂缝，也是一种相认。
lines.en: Crack to crack — that too is a kind of meeting.

lines.zh: 我身上的石粉会弄脏别人。
lines.en: The stone dust on me would soil another.

lines.zh: 有人在旁边，步子就不会乱。
lines.en: With someone beside me, my steps would not stray.

lines.zh: 我把两页纸叠在一起，算作伴。
lines.en: I fold two pages together and call it company.

lines.zh: 等我补好自己，再谈这件事。
lines.en: Let me mend myself first, then we speak of it.

lines.zh: 地上那张纸，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up that sheet from the ground.

lines.zh: 我弯腰要很久，你等一下。
lines.en: Bending takes me a while; wait a moment.

lines.zh: 这本旧书，正缺一页。
lines.en: This old book is missing exactly one page.

lines.zh: 石头我不捡，身上够多了。
lines.en: I do not pick up stones; I have enough.

lines.zh: 纸边割手，我却喜欢这感觉。
lines.en: The paper edge cuts, and I like the feeling.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都夹在袍里。
lines.en: Whatever I find, I tuck into my robe.

lines.zh: 这枚书签是谁掉的？
lines.en: Whose bookmark is this, lying here?

lines.zh: 我手指不灵，抓了三次。
lines.en: My fingers fail me; I grab three times.

lines.zh: 墨迹还没干，刚写完不久。
lines.en: The ink is still wet; it was written recently.

lines.zh: 我把拾到的纸页按顺序排好。
lines.en: I put the pages I find in order.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的经页。
lines.en: You trampled my scripture pages.

lines.zh: 站住，你身上有我要的那页。
lines.en: Stop; you carry the page I need.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝在发烫，是你惹的。
lines.en: My cracks burn hot; you caused it.

lines.zh: 别碰那座石台。
lines.en: Do not touch that stone altar.

lines.zh: 我抬手了，这次不是祝福。
lines.en: I raise my hand; this time it is no blessing.

lines.zh: 你把供物拿走，我记得。
lines.en: You took the offering. I remember.

lines.zh: 我听见你撕纸的声音。
lines.en: I heard the sound of tearing paper.

lines.zh: 这具碎身，还够打你一次。
lines.en: This broken body can still strike you once.

lines.zh: 你笑我碎，那就别走。
lines.en: You laughed at my cracks; then do not leave.

lines.zh: 我要把你的书收回来。
lines.en: I will take that book back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一路掉着石屑。
lines.en: I follow you, shedding stone dust the whole way.

lines.zh: 你走快些，我腿脚不齐。
lines.en: Walk as fast as you like; my legs are uneven.

lines.zh: 我的影子裂成两半，还在追。
lines.en: My shadow splits in two and still chases you.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就装成石像。
lines.en: When you look back, I freeze like a statue.

lines.zh: 纸页在我袖子里响，别怕。
lines.en: Pages rustle in my sleeve; do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，我一直在中间。
lines.en: You circled three times; I stayed in the middle.

lines.zh: 我念着你的名字，走得很稳。
lines.en: I recite your name and walk steadily.

lines.zh: 门后那条路，我早堵上了。
lines.en: The path behind that door — I blocked it already.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，你总会停下来。
lines.en: I need not run; you will stop eventually.

lines.zh: 光从我胸口漏出来，照着你。
lines.en: Light leaks from my chest and falls on you.

lines.zh: 这一掌，带着石头的重量。
lines.en: This palm carries the weight of stone.

lines.zh: 我挥臂，碎片跟着飞出去。
lines.en: I swing my arm, and shards fly with it.

lines.zh: 别躲，我只打一下。
lines.en: Do not dodge; I strike only once.

lines.zh: 我的拳头裂开，砸得更重。
lines.en: My fist splits open and hits harder.

lines.zh: 这招是殿前学的，忘了一半。
lines.en: I learned this in the temple; I forgot half.

lines.zh: 你退后，我的动作收不住。
lines.en: Step back; I cannot stop my swing.

lines.zh: 石头砸在你甲上，声音很脆。
lines.en: Stone strikes your armor with a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 我用断臂横扫，够得着你。
lines.en: I sweep with a broken arm; it still reaches.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我要歇很久。
lines.en: After this blow, I must rest a long while.

lines.zh: 别怨我，是你先动的手。
lines.en: Do not blame me; you struck first.

lines.zh: 我从石台后面站起来。
lines.en: I rise from behind the stone altar.

lines.zh: 身上的裂缝，醒来时就有。
lines.en: These cracks were there when I woke.

lines.zh: 殿顶塌了，我却还在。
lines.en: The roof fell in; I remain.

lines.zh: 有人在暗处念了我的名字。
lines.en: Someone spoke my name in the dark.

lines.zh: 我拍掉膝上的灰，站直。
lines.en: I brush the dust from my knees and stand straight.

lines.zh: 这一觉，睡了几百年。
lines.en: That sleep lasted several hundred years.

lines.zh: 香火早断了，我还守着。
lines.en: The incense died long ago; I still keep watch.

lines.zh: 我数了数，身上少了三块。
lines.en: I counted; three pieces are missing from me.

lines.zh: 光顺着裂缝亮起，我睁眼。
lines.en: Light runs along my cracks; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 又有人走进这座废殿了。
lines.en: Someone has entered this ruined hall again.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的裂缝，石头发红。
lines.en: Fire heats my cracks until the stone glows.

lines.zh: 落地时，我又少了一块。
lines.en: Landing costs me another piece.

lines.zh: 水从裂口涌进胸腔，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water pours into my chest; I go down slowly.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪，掀散我半边身子。
lines.en: The blast scatters half of my body.

lines.zh: 箭钉在缝里，像一根针。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in a seam like a needle.

lines.zh: 咒语钻进裂缝，念得比我快。
lines.en: The spell slips into my cracks, faster than my reciting.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我连纸都想嚼。
lines.en: When starving, I would chew even paper.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我身上的光更亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; the light inside me burns brighter.

lines.zh: 往下坠时，碎石先我一步散开。
lines.en: Falling, my stones scatter ahead of me.
